changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2b, item 8: enabled exactOptionalPropertyTypes and fixed the 19 src + 1 test compile errors it surfaced, widening internal option types to accept explicit undefined and fixing one real behavioral gap (ObservableTransport.hasPerRequestStream now always returns a boolean, matching the MCP SDK's own `=== true` check). App package with no published .d.ts; no external-facing change.
